*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint*  – https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

*Anthropic put a trained philosopher on staff to decide who Claude is, and the 84-page document she wrote is addressed directly to the model.*

The priority order inside it is safe, ethical, compliant, then helpful. If you run your business on *Claude*, you are number four, and that turns out to be the reason it can be trusted with the keys.

What you'll learn:
✅ Why *reasons* generalize better than 2,700 words of rules
✅ The line that lets Claude *refuse* Anthropic, and its one catch
✅ How to write the same document for your own business

The gap between refusing Anthropic and refusing oversight is the whole design.
